lang: Hebrew (English summary pp. 73*-75* included in the PDF)
location_note: Next to and north of the synagogue at Moza (Qusr Melek el-Yahud); map ref. NIG 21565-75/63330-35, OIG 16565-75/13330-35.
notes: Documented in 2000 during development: three plastered underground vaults of a Crusader water reservoir (Vaults I-II c. 1700 cu m; Vault III c. 45 cu m, reused as a modern drain) under a Crusader hall; supply channel end near Vault II; plastered chute into Vault III; ceramic pipe draining a staircase. Hall, courtyard and later walls not eligible.

features.subtype: underground vaulted water reservoir: Vaults I-II (ashlar, pointed ceilings, plastered) and Vault III
features.quote: The vaults are part of an underground water reservoir

features.subtype: end of a supply channel by Vault II (from the springs to the west), plastered sloping chute into Vault III, ceramic drain pipe from a staircase
features.quote: The end of a channel was discovered close to the northwestern corner
